facts.text: I am planning a gift for my cousin Rachel's baby boy Lucas.
I am looking for popular baby toys or clothes for a 2-month-old baby boy.
I am thinking of a personalized blanket as a gift.
I am considering ordering the personalized blanket from a good website or store.
I plan to check out Etsy for a unique and handmade blanket.
I am deciding whether to personalize the blanket with the name "Lucas" or with "Lucas, born January 15th".
I decided to go with "Lucas, born January 15th" for the blanket personalization.
I am considering including a gift note or card with the blanket.
I am considering whether to mention that I have been helping out my neighbor Karen with her twins in the gift note or card.
I wrote a gift note addressed to Rachel that congratulates her on the arrival of baby Lucas.
The gift note says the blanket is a small token of love and best wishes for Lucas's future.
The gift note includes a message wishing Lucas will stay cozy and warm as he grows and explores.
The gift note says the writer has been thinking about Rachel and her family a lot lately.
The gift note mentions new babies in our lives and describes it as an exciting time.
The gift note is signed with "Love, [Your Name]".
